title: CRAB-H: Task-Centric Certification for Healthcare Autonomous Systems
description:
arXiv:2611.31470v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper introduces CRAB H as a task-centric certification methodology for healthcare autonomous systems. CRAB H extends the ARC governance architecture by introducing the task as a first-class governance object, represented through Task Requirement Profiles TRP H. Each profile defines the cognitive capabilities, governance constraints, evidentiary requirements, and operational assumptions necessary for the safe execution of a specific healthcar
